Nav.TaglineDesc: No cloud, no OBS, no extra keystrokes. Just play.

Dash.HeroTitle:
Good hunting.
Not a single moment lost.
Dash.HeroDesc: Just play. Your best moments are saved automatically.
Dash.MemoryPressure: RAM limit reached: start of clip may be trimmed
Dash.NoClipsTitle: Your first hunt is yet to come
Dash.NoClipsDesc: Launch the game or select a monitor in Settings. Real clips will appear here.
Gallery.Title: Relive the moment
Gallery.EmptyDesc: After the first save, a preview of your actual clip will appear here.
Settings.Notice: Changes will restart the buffer. Pending highlights will be saved first.
Settings.UnsavedChangesPrompt: You have unsaved changes in settings. Would you like to save them before leaving?
Video.Title: Direct from the game into memory
Video.Subtitle: WGC captures via Windows API. Encoding via GPU without external tools.
Video.SourceHint: In window mode, desktop is not captured when game is inactive. Monitor explicitly captures the entire display.
Video.GpuHint: Auto selects the GPU connected to the display. If the selected card is unavailable, the default adapter is used.
Video.EncoderHint: Auto picks AMF / NVENC / QSV by the display's GPU. Validated at startup; no silent CPU fallback.
Video.GopHint: 1s GOP provides precise trimming without re-encoding. HDR and 10-bit not supported: please use SDR.
Audio.Title: The sound of your hunt
Audio.Subtitle: WASAPI loopback · AAC 48 kHz · stereo
Audio.OutputHint: All audio played on selected headphones/speakers is captured, including Discord and browser.
Audio.TracksHint: In separate tracks mode, track 1 is game audio, track 2 is mic. Standard players usually play track 1.
Audio.CardBottom: If headphones are unplugged or Windows switches endpoints, an error is logged. Auto-restart retries up to 3 times.
Replay.Title: Plenty of time before and after
Replay.Subtitle: Compressed packets remain in RAM. Disk is only used when saving a clip.
Replay.BufferHint: 60 seconds at 40 Mbps ≈ 286 MiB. Unfinished kill streaks hold extra GOPs temporarily.
Replay.CoalesceCheck: Coalesce consecutive events into a single highlight
Replay.CoalesceHint: Default merge window is 15 seconds. File appears after waiting for next kill, without padding.
Storage.Title: Your local highlight library
Storage.Subtitle: Fast-start MP4 · original quality · zero re-encoding
Storage.DirHint: Only MP4 files are placed in this folder. Thumbnails and metadata are kept in the app data directory.
Storage.AutoCleanup: Automatically delete old clips when disk limit is reached
Storage.CleanupHint: Cleanup only removes clips created by Studio. Foreign files and active clips are untouched.
System.Title: Let Studio run quietly in the background
System.Subtitle: Administrator rights are only needed by MessageBus installer, never for capture or gameplay.
System.SoundOnSave: Short sound on successful clip save
System.OverlayHint: Appears when a clip is saved, the buffer starts or stops, or recording fails. Clicks pass through it, it never takes focus from the game and it is never recorded into clips. Not shown in exclusive fullscreen mode: use borderless or windowed mode to see it in game.
System.StartWithWindows: Start with Windows · minimized to tray
System.AutoBuffer: Start buffer with game and stop on exit
System.CloseToTray: Closing window minimizes application to system tray
System.TrayHint: Manual stop pauses automation until next game launch. To exit completely, use the tray icon menu.
System.DiagnosticsCardDesc: Checks DLL, registry keys, pipe status, and encoder support.
Diag.Title: Transparency instead of promises
Diag.Subtitle: All checks run locally. No telemetry, no startup DLL injection, no silent fallback to CPU.
Diag.NvidiaDesc: Installation validates MessageBus.dll signature and backs up previous registry keys. Recovery never touches foreign keys or saved clips.
Wizard.Title: Welcome to HuntReplay Studio
Wizard.Heading: Your hunt. Already recorded.
Wizard.Subtitle: Initialize NVIDIA Highlights for Hunt: Showdown and other compatible games — on AMD, Intel, and NVIDIA.
Wizard.Step1Desc: Embedded original NVIDIA → C:\NvidiaShim. Installer validates SHA-256 and Windows digital signature.
Wizard.Step2Desc: UAC is requested only for the DLL and 4 HKLM values. The recorder itself runs entirely without administrator rights.
Wizard.ReplaceCheck: Allow replacing existing NVIDIA registration (with backup)
